verdict.rationale: The core Cactus engine and Needle models run entirely locally: install via brew and `cactus run`, with no GPU, no server and no data leaving the device. The base model is downloadable without a key, and local LoRA fine-tuning is free with the open-source package. Hands-on users confirm running it on their own phones and desktops. missing for 10: full-model training, the trained confidence head and 2-bit exports remain hosted-platform-only, and the evidence does not state an explicit open-source license or self-hosting guide for the platform/API layer.
